notes: Five distinct part-level interaction episodes are supported: one lounge-chair backrest and four barbecue components. The two side-shelf episodes are less certain because camera roll and partial occlusion make their folded versus deployed configurations harder to distinguish.
scene_description: A user moves around a covered apartment balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a stainless-steel gas barbecue, manipulating several movable parts while the camera circles the scene.
